nodes.title: Benchmark compression across all handlers
nodes.description: Build a TUI benchmark that measures byte and token savings per handler, verifies losslessness, and produces a screenshot-ready report for the README.

nodes.title: Near-duplicate output collapse
nodes.description: Collapse near-identical stored outputs (repeated file reads, paginated API calls) into one canonical item with a seen-count to cut storage and search noise.

nodes.title: Profile feedback loop
nodes.description: Track which fields Claude actually retrieves and auto-suggest refinements to generated profiles so compression improves over time.

nodes.title: Cross-project knowledge tier
nodes.description: Optional global tier for notes and decisions searchable across repositories, turning recall from a per-repo cache into a personal knowledge base.

nodes.title: Token-savings dashboard in recall__stats
nodes.description: Show estimated tokens saved alongside byte figures so users can see the context-window impact directly.

nodes.title: Handle malformed JSON in profile strategies
nodes.description: json_extract and json_truncate should fall back to a text excerpt when the payload fails to parse instead of returning empty.

nodes.title: Unicode-safe chunking
nodes.description: Chunk on rune boundaries so multibyte content is never split mid-character.
